reviews.review:
At the time of writing this, I cannot recommend this game.

In February 2022, there is only a very, very tiny amount of people playing this, I wouldn't be surprised if there was less than 100 people as its daily peak. 

Once you have played through the campaign, you have seen it all. The only thing to do beyond the campaign would be cosmetics, achievements, or upgrades. Anything beyond 'intense' (hard) difficulty isn't rewarding, and the lack of new story content, even after 2 season updates means that players from Day One have been left with months of the same missions, and dialogue, and enemies, etc. 

If the campaign was twice as long, with quicker and more meaningful content updates (which would require a bigger team than they have now), then I think it would be worth the 40 USD it started with.

This Game has the chance to been a good game but sadly it fall's short first of it 100% Team play above the most easy setting so you need 3 friends to do the hard levels that leads to problem 2 there men't to be a online match system to find other players in 8 hour's play iv one found 1 other player and they quit 3rd the content is very small and can be done very quick there is few drops on weapons and perks and there is a level system for the toon's and weapons but this is a more of rinse and repeat same levels over and over in all i say this more like a demo game of a much better game to come.

When I bought this this game was the ♥♥♥♥.

I mean it was ♥♥♥♥♥♥♥ everything I was looking for and the co-op idea was good.but I still think people should dive into it.

A friend and I play a lot of co-op mission-based games together, only PvE not PVP, and we are still enjoying this game on our second playthrough at about 45 hrs play time.

With only 2 players we have to take a bot along and it was hard enough that our first playthrough needed to be on standard difficulty (we can usually beat most games e.g. ZA4, Strange Brigade, etc. on max difficulty & enemies). We are now playing all missions again on Intense and it's quite different, the AI (bot) becomes a bit less useful and stands in our line of fire etc., but the game is awesome fun and we are still enjoying it a lot. We are old enough that we saw Alien and Aliens when they first came out and I've probably watched Aliens 10-20 times since, still love it, and this game captures the atmosphere beautifully.

One thing I'd say surprised me is that after initially thinking "what only 12 missions?" they're actually randomised and chaotic enough to stay fun and interesting. You mostly know where the bad guys are... Mostly....
Fun in a pick up and play kind of way. Best played with friends on a voice connection. Kind of dull with randoms or bots.
